name: Both Hands Up
description: Both wrists raised above head height.

name: Left Hand Up
description: Left wrist raised above head height.

name: Right Hand Up
description: Right wrist raised above head height.

name: Hands Down
description: Both hands resting below head height.

name: T-Pose
description: Arms stretched out horizontally at shoulder height.

name: Arms Crossed
description: Wrists crossed in front of the chest.

name: Lean Left
description: Upper body leaning to the left.

name: Lean Right
description: Upper body leaning to the right.

name: Squat / Crouch
description: Hips lowered close to knee height.

name: Head Down
description: Head lowered or bowed down toward the chest.

name: Sit Down
description: Transition from standing to a lowered posture.

name: Stand Up
description: Transition from a lowered posture back to standing.

name: Wave Left Hand
description: Left hand raised and waved side to side.

name: Wave Right Hand
description: Right hand raised and waved side to side.

name: Left Fist Closed
description: Left hand closed into a fist.

name: Left Fist Open
description: Left hand open with fingers extended.

name: Right Fist Closed
description: Right hand closed into a fist.

name: Right Fist Open
description: Right hand open with fingers extended.
